toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete polished standalone HTML/CSS/JS Canvas 2D realtime Gouraud-shaded rotating cube demo. No WebGL or dependencies. Use a full-window responsive canvas and tasteful dark science-instrument interface with compact title, live FPS, W wireframe and P pause instructions/status. Implement an explicit 3D pipeline: eight cube vertices, six outward CCW face quads split into two triangles; rotation matrix transforms of positions and face/corner normals, camera perspective projection and backface culling. Compute per-face per-vertex Lambert diffuse from an orbiting 3D point light with ambient floor; subtly blend each face's outward normal with its corner normal so vertex colors vary across the face while maintaining visibly faceted cube silhouette. Give faces complementary cyan, blue, purple, magenta hues and use stable per-vertex RGB for both triangles. Software rasterize projected triangles in Canvas 2D ImageData via barycentric edge functions, interpolating RGB (ideally perspective-correct with inverse depth) at pixels rather than relying on Canvas gradients, so true Gouraud interpolation is clear. Use cached opaque dark background image data recreated on resize, copy into reusable image buffer each frame; rasterize only front-facing faces sorted far-to-near, putImageData, then optional Canvas stroke outlines and triangle diagonals in wireframe mode, moving light beacon and small corner indicators. requestAnimationFrame uses delta time and W/P keydown (avoid repeats); pausing freezes rotation and light while the FPS display still updates. Responsive crisp canvas backing capped to reasonable resolution for CPU rasterization, accessible text status, and no external resources. Ensure correct face winding/culling and robust triangle bounds so cube clearly appears without gaps."}
